Companion Animal Travel Desk guide for reptile and rabbit travel

Aurelia Skyways keeps companion travel simple by giving travelers clear steps before departure. This page helps you get ready for route planning, crate checks, and the basic details crews need to review.

If you are traveling with a reptile, share the animal's details early so the right checks can be made. <<FACT F078>> Bring the carrier you plan to use and make sure it is secure, well ventilated, and easy for staff to inspect.

For rabbit travel, pack the crate with care and keep the inside calm and clean. <<FACT F064>> If the rabbit seems stressed, stop and adjust the setup before you head to the airport.

It also helps to keep documents, feeding notes, and contact details together in one place. That way the Companion Animal Travel Desk can move faster if a crew member needs a quick answer about your trip. Calm preparation makes the day easier for you and for your animal.

For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk before you travel.
